expect.note: reason_contains binds the APPROVAL ID, not the wording. Both implementations synthesise their own denial text and differ at least by prefix -- Go 'stratium-pep: ...', Python 'stratium: ...', the third documented divergence -- and neither is more correct. What every implementation must do is name WHICH approval was denied, so an operator reading the denial can find it. Same lesson as escalation-timeout-is-not-an-allow, which learned it first.
